page.title: CV
page.description: Your base CV is a selection from your career profile. Save it, preview the layout, download a PDF, and commit a version to a private GitHub repository.

sections.empty: Nothing here yet. Add items on your career profile, then include them.

github.title: GitHub
github.description: Connect a private repository to commit cvs/base.json and cvs/base.html with each saved version. The token is stored encrypted and is never shown again.
github.notConnected: GitHub is not connected. Versions stay in Matchbox until you connect a repository.
